candidate.answerReason: The elapsed flight time is 2 hours 44 minutes, so h+m=46.

methods.label: Count the elapsed time
methods.explanation:
Both cities use the same time zone, so we can compare the clock readings directly. From \(10{:}34\) am to \(12{:}34\) pm is \(2\) hours. From \(12{:}34\) pm to \(1{:}18\) pm is
\[
(60-34)+18=44
\]
minutes. Thus \(h=2\) and \(m=44\), which satisfies \(0\le m<60\). Therefore
\[
h+m=2+44=\boxed{46},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
methods.levelReason: Only elapsed-time reasoning, the 60-minute hour, and elementary addition and subtraction are needed.
